rules.statement: A district court has the power to order that the costs of execution of an order for the payment of costs made in a partition action under the Partition Act should be recovered from the judgment-debtor.
rules.supporting_quote: "In an action instituted under the Partition Act, No. 16 of 1951, it is competent for the Court to order that the costs of execution of an order for the payment of costs made in the final decree should be recovered from the judgment-debtor."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 208 and 209 of the Civil Procedure Code relating to the recovery of costs of execution are applicable to proceedings under the Partition Act.
